item.title: Over 100 worshippers abducted in coordinated church attacks in Kaduna
item.description: Gunmen suspected to be bandits have abducted more than 100 worshippers during coordinated attacks on three churches in Kaduna State. The attacks occurred on Sunday in Kurmin Wali community, located in Kajuru Local Government Area. The assailants reportedly struck during church services, arriving in large numbers and carrying out the raids almost simultaneously.
